answer: The kiln keeps its own log, the maker keeps the receipt, and any stranger can match the two. Time is the toll no farm can skip: 10 minutes per proof, 8800 minutes for 880, due every single epoch. The farm's garden is its mask, its sable its bribe, its echo its alibi — and the panel checks the alibi first, because alibis break first. When the panel doubts everything else, Chancery scribe diploma sheet proof lettered across the lettering table still stands, and its standing is each diploma sheet is a measured sheet yield plus a calligrapher signature.
